candidate: Murray et al. 2021 Chicago coyote multi-season camera survey

published_design.published_model_boundary: coyote occurrence was fitted as a multi-season autologistic state; EOG future endpoint will be the recorded seasonal detection state, not latent biological absence

site_registry.role: response-independent site registry and conventional urban covariates

future_response.future_observed_endpoint: season-level recorded coyote detection: positive if >=1 weekly detection among active weeks; recorded negative only when camera effort is present and no weekly coyote detection occurs

join_gate.rule: all 113 model_covariates site IDs must exactly match response-free coordinate site IDs

prospective_estimability.published_support: 16 seasons x 113 sites; published naive coyote occupancy averaged 0.45 and coyote was photographed at 78% of sites across seasons
prospective_estimability.reason: endpoint-matched 0->1 and 0->0 counts under a future frozen temporal split are not published; exact count gate remains mandatory before fitting

no_rescue: do not open coyote_detection_data.csv to alter node geometry or scale
do not weaken exact Site-ID coverage
do not substitute the paper's fitted autologistic parameter for EOG structural scale
do not add candidate-specific connectivity operators
